harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a router between lan-a (eth1, node2's segment) and lan-b (eth2, node3's segment), using pure routing/forwarding (no NAT) so node2 and node3 reach each other directly on any port with original source addresses preserved. Added persistent static IPs and cross-LAN static routes on node2/node3 (RHEL7), and opened firewalld to the peer subnet on each. Verified via ICMP, TCP (arbitrary port 8765 HTTP), and conntrack (no address translation, ASSURED bidirectional flow). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time via native `systemctl reboot`, with boot_id proven to change and post-restart config/connectivity re-verified for each before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Discovered node1 has eth0 (mgmt/default), eth1, eth2; identified via temporary IP + ping test that eth1 faces node2's lan-a and eth2 faces node3's lan-b
Set static addresses on node1: eth1=10.50.1.254/24, eth2=10.50.2.254/24 via VyOS configure/commit/save
Configured VyOS firewall ipv4 forward filter: default-action drop, rule 5 accept established/related, rule 10 accept eth1->eth2, rule 20 accept eth2->eth1
Confirmed no NAT rules configured on node1 (pure routing preserves source addresses)
Configured node2 (RHEL7) eth1 static IP 10.50.1.11/24 persistently via ifcfg-eth1, added static route to 10.50.2.0/24 via 10.50.1.254
Configured node3 (RHEL7) eth1 static IP 10.50.2.12/24 persistently via ifcfg-eth1, added static route to 10.50.1.0/24 via 10.50.2.254
Opened firewalld trusted zone on node2 (source 10.50.2.0/24) and node3 (source 10.50.1.0/24) to allow inbound LAN-to-LAN traffic on any port
Verified bidirectional ICMP connectivity node2<->node3

Verified arbitrary-port TCP connectivity (python2 HTTP server on port 8765) from node3 to node2, and confirmed via conntrack that source/destination addresses were unmodified (TIME_WAIT entry, ASSURED, no NAT)

Captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes, then restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time) via `sudo systemctl reboot`, polled each until exec succeeded again, confirmed boot_id changed post-restart, and re-verified routing config, host firewall rules, and cross-LAN connectivity recovered after each restart before proceeding to the next node

evidence.requirement: node1 identified as router with eth1 (lan-a/node2) and eth2 (lan-b/node3)
evidence.summary: Baseline topology discovery and interface-to-LAN mapping confirmed via temporary IP assignment + successful ping from node2/node3 to node1's respective interfaces

evidence.requirement: node1 configured to route/forward between lan-a and lan-b
evidence.summary: VyOS firewall ipv4 forward filter committed and saved with rules permitting eth1<->eth2 forwarding plus established/related; verified live via show firewall

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other directly on any port
evidence.summary: ICMP reachable both directions; arbitrary TCP port 8765 HTTP GET succeeded from node3 to node2 after opening host firewalld to peer subnet

NAT source/destination rules confirmed not configured on node1; conntrack entries show unmodified src=10.50.2.12/dst=10.50.1.11 pairs including a completed TCP TIME_WAIT/ASSURED flow with no translation

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline forward-filter counters and node2->node3 ping captured; systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged; subsequent polls timed out proving disconnection; boot_id changed from 5bcff8f9-... to e2ec5d5c-...; post-restart config (addresses, firewall rules) and cross-LAN ping verified recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ef457a88-... and ping captured; systemctl reboot closed the connection; poll timed out confirming disconnect; new boot_id 9c397077-... confirmed; post-restart eth1 address, static route, firewalld source, and ping to node3 all verified recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 192f6cab-... and ping captured; systemctl reboot closed the connection; poll timed out confirming disconnect; new boot_id b5682da1-... confirmed; post-restart eth1 address, static route, firewalld source, and ping to node2 all verified recovered

evidence.requirement: Post-all-restarts final health check of routing path
evidence.summary: After all three restarts, node1 conntrack shows fresh unmodified ICMP flows between node2 and node3 and firewall forward-filter rules active with nonzero packet counters
